physics_orchestrator_architecture.principle: Orchestrator is a thin, auditable control plane over interchangeable solvers. It owns: experiment specification, solver dispatch, provenance, observable extraction, falsification verdicts. It NEVER contains physics.
core_abstractions: ObservableExtractor (raw fields to scalar time series)
physics_orchestrator_architecture.minimum_viable_v0: ~500-1000 lines Python. Two SolverAdapters (OpenFOAM, FEBio). Parameter sweep driver (Latin Hypercube). Results table (pandas/parquet). Provenance manifests. Report generator.
physics_orchestrator_architecture.ai_surrogate_boundary: Truth generator = OpenFOAM/FEBio. Surrogate = accelerator only. Surrogate must state training domain and refuse extrapolation. NEVER reverse (per CEO principle).
physics_orchestrator_architecture.strongest_alternative: Orchestration is a commodity — InSteps already owns the integrated platform. Our survival: orchestrator must encode adversarial falsification of a specific mechanism (pre-fragmentation signal), not generic virtual trials.

stage_minus_1_virtual_falsification_desi.question: Can a pre-fragmentation signal >=1s before fracture exist under realistic simulated conditions?
stage_minus_1_virtual_falsification_desi.engines: OpenFOAM (pulsatile flow) + FEBio (viscoelastic/poroelastic clot). Two independent paths: Path A (one-way FSI), Path B (SPH replication via DualSPHysics).
observables: Max principal stress/strain at clot neck
Pre-fragmentation candidate signal: any observable with >=1s lead-time separability
stage_minus_1_virtual_falsification_desi.virtual_experiment_count: 200-500 runs (4-parameter Latin Hypercube). Feasible in days-weeks of wall clock on CPU.
stage_minus_1_virtual_falsification_desi.kill_condition: If NO observable shows >=1s lead-time separability (AUC <0.7) across the full DOE under ANY realistic parameter combination, the mechanism hypothesis is falsified IN SILICO. Stage 0 wet-lab spend is BLOCKED.
stage_minus_1_virtual_falsification_desi.relationship_to_stage_0: Stage -1 output = parameter envelope + ranked observables. Stage 0 protocol remains FROZEN. Stage -1 cannot modify Stage 0, only inform which observables get sensor priority.
stage_minus_1_virtual_falsification_desi.strongest_alternative_explanation: The 'signal' is an artifact of the assumed clot constitutive model. Mitigation: require signal in BOTH Path A (continuum damage) and Path B (peridynamics/SPH) — two fracture formalisms with different artifacts.
